description.html: On this model the 35 cm height is almost twice the side of the base, which measures 20x20 cm. The volume is 14 liters. The back wall is covered by a 3D background, and air enters and leaves through a mesh vent, which matters because in narrow, tall terrariums moisture otherwise lingers near the bottom.

Those 5 extra cm compared with the 20x20x30 model are used for a plant or a branch set at an angle from the bottom toward the top. For mantises of larger species this gives a safer space for molting. Jumping spiders stay in the upper third, so put food in without destroying the nest. Small day geckos also need a source of UVB light above the mesh.

If you plan a live plant and a drainage layer, consider the 40 cm height with the same base. We choose rock or bark for the background together. Custom terrariums of this size are finished within 7 to 14 days. On the outside it gets a film of your choice, so it can match the shelf it stands on.
